{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''pirate''' faced off against a [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Farstine)|bounty hunter]] and his [[Unidentified child (Dantooine)|young sidekick]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] was wrestled out of a hatch by the [[Youngling/Legends|kid]], forcing the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] jump from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] to the surface of the world, using an [[ablative heatshield]] and a [[Parachute/Legends|parachute]] to rescue their companion.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
